Danish hundrede

    From Old Norse hundrað (“hundred”).

    Pronunciation

    • IPA(key): /hunrədə/, [ˈhunɐðð̩]

    Numeral

    hundrede

    1. hundred
      Synonym: hundred
    2. hundredth

    Noun

    hundrede n (plural indefinite hundreder or hundrede, plural definite hundrederne)

    1. a unit of about one hundred
